title: Bound actual governance contributor reads in Human Inbox

source_deadline_audit.unknown_physical_trigger_note: Original physical trigger of the 5th reload timeout at 2026-11-06T03:33:17Z (per-owner SQL/HTTP timings/HAR not captured in browser audit) remains unknown; source proof is limited to the proven deadline propagation gap, default DeploymentPlanPort failure-swallowing gap, and reproduced slow/failing owner reads.

admitted_scope_repairs.change: Make cached_owner_call budget-aware using remaining_management_read_budget() on per-key lock acquisition and pre-invocation checks while preserving request/caller/tenant failure caching; forward remaining_management_read_budget() as timeout to http_request_json and evolution_owner_request when a management_read_deadline is active without altering default non-management calls.

Accept optional timeout in call_owner and list_decisions, bounding GET /api/governance/approvals to remaining_management_read_budget() when management_read_deadline is active (failing fast with TimeoutError when <= 0.0) while preserving the 15s default for non-management and write calls.

Forward explicit timeout from http_request_json GET calls to command_executor._get_json when provided, and bound urllib.request.urlopen in http_request_json and evolution_owner_request to effective_timeout (raising TimeoutError when <= 0.0) while keeping 30s default for non-management and write calls.
Accept optional timeout in _get_json and bound urllib.request.urlopen to min(_REQUEST_TIMEOUT, timeout) (raising TimeoutError when <= 0.0) while keeping the 30s default when timeout is None.

Preserve the underlying provider/store exception in request-scoped port cache alongside ('unavailable', []) and add raise_on_error: bool = False to DeploymentPlanPort.list_deployment_plans so governance review queue reads propagate real DeploymentPlanPort timeouts and errors instead of returning a false healthy empty list.

Reuse core.owner_reads.cached_owner_call for request/caller/tenant-scoped memoization of approval_decisions, deployment_plans, and evolution_decisions readers, invoking DeploymentPlanPort with raise_on_error=True while preserving all linked terminal approval outcomes for DeploymentPlan allowedActions.

Tighten management_read_deadline inside get_human_inbox to the contributor surface budget (min(human_inbox_surface_timeout_seconds(), outer_remaining), default 1.0s); prewarm review_queue readers on _HEALTH_OWNER_READ_EXECUTOR via submit_owner_read; classify contributor deadline/socket timeouts as read_timeout; and check rem is not None and rem <= 0.0 when classifying unavailable deployment_plans.

Set PANTHEON_BFF_HUMAN_INBOX_SURFACE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=0.05 alongside PANTHEON_BFF_MANAGEMENT_READ_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=0.05 and verify partial=True, surfaces.human_inbox.status=='degraded', and surfaces.governance_review_queue.reason=='read_timeout'.
